properties.name: Three Day Rule
properties.description: Never stays in any one country longer than three days.

properties.name: Witness Stance
properties.description: Observes a place's customs without judging or interfering, and takes only what is needed.

properties.name: Quick Draw
properties.description: Exceptionally fast and accurate with handguns, used almost entirely in self-defence.

properties.name: Survival Craft
properties.description: Resourceful on the road: repairs, rations, scavenges and navigates hard terrain.

properties.name: Road Companion
properties.description: Travels with a talking motorcycle that reasons and argues as an equal; a partnership, not ownership.

properties.name: Traveler Limits
properties.description: Carries only what one vehicle can hold; no allies, resources or authority beyond what the road provides.

visual_traits.descriptor: lean, wiry frame of a seasoned wanderer, light on its feet
a calm, even-featured face with steady dark eyes and a faint polite smile
a belted brown travel coat with deep pockets, a wide-brimmed cap and pushed-up goggles
weathered brown, olive and dust grey
a pair of holstered handguns, one at the thigh and one at the small of the back
an utter stillness that settles over a crowd, as if everything nearby were being quietly noted

exclusion_candidates.item: the talking motorcycle as a carried companion
exclusion_candidates.reason: A separate being, not a trait.

exclusion_candidates.item: the episodic structure of visiting one country at a time
the closing refrain about the beauty of the world
